# Contact APIs

You can use the our Contact APIs to create, update or deactivate contacts. You can perform most of these actions from the [RazorpayX Dashboard](https://x.razorpay.com/auth) as well.

## List of APIs

The table below lists the various Contacts APIs and gives a brief description of each API:

API | Description
---
[Create a Contact](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/contacts/create.md) | Creates a new Contact.
---
[Update a Contact](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/contacts/update.md) | Updates an existing Contact.
---
[Activate or Deactivate a Contact](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/contacts/activate-or-deactivate.md) | Activates or deactivates an existing contact.
---
[Fetch all Contacts](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/contacts/fetch-all.md) | Retrieves all the Contacts.
---
[Fetch a Contact with ID](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/contacts/fetch-with-id.md) | Retrieves a single Contact with ID.
